title: Improve LWS scraper name matching
description:
## Problem
The Lampwork Supply scraper is only matching 231 out of 1,393 scraped products (212 by name, 19 by SKU). User believes all LWS glass colors should be in our catalog, so we need to investigate why matches are failing.

## What Was Done
1. Created and deployed the LWS scraper at:
   - `~/molten-project/molten-website/src/lib/scrapers/lampworksupply.ts`
   - `~/molten-project/molten-website/src/pages/api/v1/stock/scrape/lampworksupply.ts`
   - Migration: `migrations/0005_add_lws_abr_retailers.sql` (already applied)

2. Fixed one issue: Added slash-to-space conversion in normalizeName() to match "Amber/Purple" (our catalog) with "Amber Purple" (LWS). This improved matches from 229 to 231.

## Key Findings

### SKU Matching Is Limited
- LWS uses internal SKUs (like "11" for Amber Purple, "641" for Alaskan Thunder) not manufacturer codes
- Only products where LWS happens to use NS-XXX format match by SKU (e.g., "NS-143" for Absinthe)
- This is expected behavior - name matching is the primary strategy

### Name Matching Investigation Needed
When rate limiting clears, run this analysis:

```python
# Compare LWS product names to our catalog
# LWS API: https://lampworksupply.com/api/category/search/2?page=1&per_page=500&sort=name&direction=asc&category_id=2&in_stock=1
# Our catalog: ~/projects/purchases/Molten/Sources/Resources/catalog.sqlite
# Table: glass_items WHERE manufacturer = 'NS'

# Check for:
# 1. Names that normalize differently
# 2. Products in LWS not in our catalog at all
# 3. Spelling differences (e.g., "Experimental" vs "Exp.")
```

### Data Points
- Our catalog: ~178 Northstar items
- LWS Northstar in stock: 444 products (many are same color in different forms: rod, frit, powder, etc.)
- LWS has ~59 unique color names in first 200 products

### Potential Name Mismatch Patterns to Investigate
1. Experimental colors: LWS uses "Exp. #130 Jolly Lollipop", "EXP Green #5", etc.
2. WonderTube products may have different naming
3. Some products might have slightly different color names

## Files to Reference
- Scraper: `~/molten-project/molten-website/src/lib/scrapers/lampworksupply.ts`
- Catalog DB: `~/projects/purchases/Molten/Sources/Resources/catalog.sqlite`
- ABR scraper (reference): `~/molten-project/molten-website/src/lib/scrapers/abr.ts`

## API Details
- Endpoint: `/api/category/search/{category_id}`
- Pagination: `?page=N&per_page=100`
- In-stock filter: `&in_stock=1`
- Category IDs: 2 (Northstar), 46 (TAG), 59 (Glass Alchemy), etc.

## Next Steps
1. Wait for rate limit to clear
2. Fetch full product list from LWS
3. Run comparison script to find all unmatched color names
4. Add NAME_ALIASES mapping for any spelling variations
5. Consider if any colors are genuinely missing from our catalog

title: Build Ed Hoy's stock scraper (Magento GraphQL)
description:
## Overview
Ed Hoy's (edhoy.com) runs Magento 2 with a public GraphQL API that provides product data including SKU, price, and stock status. This makes it a good candidate for a stock scraper.

## API Details

**Endpoint:** `https://www.edhoy.com/graphql` (POST)

**Example Query:**
```graphql
{
  products(filter: {category_id: {eq: "2351"}}, pageSize: 100) {
    items {
      name
      sku
      price_range {
        minimum_price {
          regular_price { value currency }
        }
      }
      stock_status
    }
    total_count
  }
}
```

## Relevant Categories

### Boro (COE 33)
- Northstar: category 2351 (134 products)
- TAG: category 2355 (2 products)
- Schott: category 2350 (21 products)
- Simax: category 2358 (40 products)

### Soft Glass (COE 104)
- Effetre: category 2360 (199 products)
- CiM: category 2347 (95 products)
- Double Helix: category 2353 (41 products)

### Fusible Sheet Glass
- Bullseye: category 2486 (552 products)
- Oceanside: category 2498 (306 products)
- Wissmach 96: category 2503 (103 products)
- Youghiogheny 96: category 2505 (128 products)

## SKU Pattern
Ed Hoy's SKUs contain manufacturer codes:
- `1547NS155_C` → Northstar NS-155 (Ruby Slippers)
- `1547NS97_C` → Northstar NS-97 (Evergreen)
- `1547NSEXP88_C` → Northstar EXP #88 (Coma)

SKU extraction regex: `/NS(\d+|EXP\d+)/` for Northstar

## Implementation Notes
1. Create scraper at `~/molten-project/molten-website/src/lib/scrapers/edhoy.ts`
2. Create API endpoint at `~/molten-project/molten-website/src/pages/api/v1/stock/scrape/edhoy.ts`
3. Add 'edhoy' retailer to database migration
4. Use GraphQL pagination (pageSize + currentPage)
5. Match by SKU where possible, fall back to name matching

## Stock Status Values
- `IN_STOCK`
- `OUT_OF_STOCK`

## Reference Files
- LWS scraper: `~/molten-project/molten-website/src/lib/scrapers/lampworksupply.ts`
- ABR scraper: `~/molten-project/molten-website/src/lib/scrapers/abr.ts`
- Stock library: `~/molten-project/molten-website/src/lib/stock.ts`
